_comment: Copy this file to dev-overrides.json (GITIGNORED) and fill in the developer credential. The microservice authenticates to /apifront AS the developer — exactly like the CLI — using these. In prod these come from a SECRET, never from a checked-in file. defaults-config.json must NOT contain the signature (it is a credential).
_MESH_CTX_VERIFY_MODE_comment: defaults-config.json sets MESH_CTX_VERIFY_MODE to enforce, the only value a deployed service boots with. On your own machine you may relax it here: "warn" (verify and log, never refuse) or "" (no verification; every request is stamped meshContextVerified=false). Never set MESH_CTX_PUBLIC_KEY or MESH_CTX_KEY_ID in any config file: the platform key is resolved by @descix/cloud-core and a copy refuses boot.
